tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.name: Disable user tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.description: Checks disabling and re-enabling users, who may do it, and what happens to their sign-ins.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.name: Shared rate limiter tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.description: Checks the per-address request cap that is shared across server copies, using a stand-in counter and a fake clock.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.name: Rate limiter wiring tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.description: Checks that the shared request cap is actually applied to real requests and what happens when its counter fails.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dur.name: Background task leader tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dur.description: Checks that only the server copy holding leadership runs the background tasks.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dur.name: Background task resilience tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dur.description: Checks that a failure in one background task round does not take the server down, and that a stalled worker shows as degraded.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Low-stock level race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks that two people changing a grade's low-stock level at once cannot both succeed.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Low-stock level tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks who may set a grade's low-stock level and what the stock view reports about it.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Egg grade management tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks creating, renaming and deactivating egg grades, unique names, and that simultaneous edits conflict.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Egg stock ledger tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks the running record of eggs coming in and going out.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Egg lot overselling tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks that two sales confirmed against the same eggs at once cannot both take them.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Egg lot lock order tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks that confirming, voiding sales and voiding daily entries lock egg lots in one fixed order so they never deadlock.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Egg write-off tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks writing off or correcting stock on a single egg lot while the ledger stays the source of truth.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.name: Egg stock locking tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Egg.description: Checks that egg stock changes refuse to run outside a transaction.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Enr.name: Two-step sign-in time limit tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Enr.description: Checks that a signed-in session using two-step sign-in ends after the set number of days since the last full sign-in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Err.name: Error code list tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Err.description: Checks that the published list of error codes stays consistent.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Exc.name: Server error handling tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Exc.description: Checks that unexpected failures inside a request give a clean error answer, including database outages.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Exp.name: Expense tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Exp.description: Checks expense categories, recording money spent, period totals and admin corrections.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Exp.name: Data export tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Exp.description: Checks the admin-only backup downloads, one spreadsheet file per kind of data and a full zip.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm banner rollback tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks that undoing the farm banner database change does not break farms that only have a banner.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm banner tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks uploading and fetching the farm banner image.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm date tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks the farm's single sense of today's date, including edges around midnight.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm date behind UTC tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks date cut-offs for farms whose local time is behind universal time.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm date cut-off tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks that date limits across the app use the farm's local date.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm date stock and sale tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks that the stock view and sales use the farm's local date.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Logo upload size setting tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks that a bad logo size setting stops the server from starting.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Logo upload size limit tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks that an oversized logo upload is refused early, before other steps run.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm logo tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks who may upload a farm logo, what images are accepted and what comes back.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.name: Farm settings tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Far.description: Checks reading and changing farm settings, owner-only access and the currency lock.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fee.name: Feed usage lock order tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fee.description: Checks that recording feed use locks things in a fixed order so it cannot deadlock.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fee.name: Feed usage tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fee.description: Checks using feed oldest-first, per-batch cost estimates, and corrections for mistaken purchases.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fir.name: First admin unlock failure tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fir.description: Checks that a failure while releasing the setup lock does not undo an already created first owner.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fir.name: First-run sign-in notice tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fir.description: Checks that signing in on a server with no administrator explains the problem instead of a generic refusal.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fix.name: Test shortcut registration tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fix.description: Checks that the special shortcuts used for sample data can be used only where intended.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.name: Flock management tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.description: Checks updating, depleting and archiving flocks, hiding archived ones and blocking entries for closed flocks.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.name: Flock name lookup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.description: Checks that flock names are matched only among flocks a person may see, and duplicate names are reported as unclear.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.name: Flock access check tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.description: Checks how each kind of person is limited to their flocks on each request.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.name: Flock visibility tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Flo.description: Checks that a worker sees only their own flocks' records and farm-wide ones, and others appear as not found.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/For.name: Ignored proxy address logging tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/For.description: Checks that a client address passed by an untrusted proxy is ignored and logged.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/For.name: Trusted proxy address tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/For.description: Checks over real connections which proxies may tell the server a visitor's address.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fut.name: Future egg lot tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Fut.description: Checks that the stock view and the oldest-first sale allocation agree on which eggs exist.
